input_data.earnings_summary: Coinbase Global reported exceptional Q1 2024 results driven by a significant recovery in cryptocurrency market activity. Net revenue reached $1.64 billion, up 72% quarter-over-quarter and 112% year-over-year. Transaction revenue surged to $1.08 billion (+232% YoY) as crypto trading volumes spiked. Subscription and services revenue grew to $511 million, driven by USDC stablecoin revenue, blockchain rewards, and Coinbase One subscriptions. Net income came in at $1.18 billion ($4.40 EPS), the first profitable quarter since Q1 2022. Adjusted EBITDA was $1.01 billion (62% margin). Total trading volume reached $312 billion, with retail trading volume up 93% QoQ.

key_metrics.guidance_next_quarter: Q2 2024 subscription and services revenue $525M-$600M; transaction revenue dependent on crypto market conditions
